response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience (15+ years) in software engineering with a strong focus on full-stack development, cloud technologies, and AI-agent infrastructure. However, his background is heavily weighted toward traditional software development and web/mobile applications, with limited direct experience in AI strategy, cloud product leadership, or recognized expertise in AI-powered platforms. His entrepreneurial experience (GISCollective) is notable but not directly aligned with AI strategy roles.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on full-stack and cloud technologies
Entrepreneurial experience (GISCollective) demonstrating technical leadership and product development
Strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development) and polyglot programming skills
concerns: Limited direct experience in AI strategy, cloud product leadership, or AI-powered platform development
No advanced degree (Master's/PhD) in an AI-related field, which is preferred for this role
No clear demonstration of recognized expertise in AI (e.g., published work, patents, or leadership in AI initiatives)
